result.title: Causal graph fusion across incomplete cohorts and causal steering of tabular foundation models
result.summary: Clinical data are split across incomplete cohorts with partially overlapping variables. Causal discovery under missing data and multi-source integration have developed separately, and tabular foundation models cannot take a causal graph without retraining. We make two contributions. First, causal graph fusion learns a partial ancestral graph on the shared variables, fuses it into each cohort's graph under temporal background knowledge and lets Markov blankets guide re-imputation, so missing data are handled inside discovery. Second, causal attention steering compiles the learned graph into the attention of a frozen tabular foundation model at inference. Against known ground truth, fusion dominates pooled and per-cohort baselines in every missingness and heterogeneity condition tested (p<0.001), and steering improves discrimination under distribution shift (p<10^{-5}), a gain that a random graph does not produce. In two spinal cord injury cohorts, fusion orients age, albumin and hemoglobin as ancestors of length of stay, a set no single cohort orients in full, and yields compact, temporally ordered predictor sets that match or exceed automatic feature selection on four of five outcomes.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出跨不完整队列的因果图融合，使缺失值处理嵌入因果发现过程，并在推理阶段把学到的图编译进冻结表格基础模型的注意力，实现因果注意力引导。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「不重训即把外部因果图注入冻结模型注意力」的推理期引导方式，或可为 LVR 中定向写入视觉或因果证据到 latent 状态提供可核查的接线思路，但对象为表格临床数据，迁移性需进一步判断。
